title: AudioFuse: Unified Spectral-Temporal Learning via a Hybrid ViT-1D CNN Architecture for Robust Phonocardiogram Classification
abstract: arXiv:2509.23454v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Biomedical audio signals, such as phonocardiograms (PCG), are inherently rhythmic and contain diagnostic information in both their spectral (tonal) and temporal domains. Standard 2D spectrograms provide rich spectral features but compromise the phase information and temporal precision of the 1D waveform. We propose AudioFuse, an architecture that simultaneously learns from both complementary representations to classify PCGs. To mitigate the overfitting risk common in fusion models, we integrate a custom, wide-and-shallow Vision Transformer (ViT) for spectrograms with a shallow 1D CNN for raw waveforms. On the PhysioNet 2016 dataset, AudioFuse achieves a state-of-the-art competitive ROC-AUC of 0.8608 when trained from scratch, outperforming its spectrogram (0.8066) and waveform (0.8223) baselines. translated_title: AudioFuse：通过ViT-1D CNN混合架构实现统一的频谱-时域学习，用于鲁棒的心音图分类
translated_abstract: 心音图（PCG）等生物医学音频信号本质上具有节律性，其诊断信息同时蕴含在频域和时域中。标准的2D频谱图虽然提供了丰富的频谱特征，但会损失1D波形的相位信息和时间精度。我们提出了AudioFuse，这是一种能够同时从两种互补表示中学习的架构，用于心音图分类。为了降低融合模型中常见的过拟合风险，我们集成了一种定制的宽而浅的视觉Transformer（ViT）来处理频谱图，并结合一个浅层1D CNN来处理原始波形。在PhysioNet 2016数据集上，AudioFuse在从零开始训练的情况下实现了具有竞争力的最先进ROC-AUC 0.8608，优于其频谱图基线（0.8066）和波形基线（0.8223）。此外，它在具有挑战性的PASCAL数据集上展现出对域偏移的卓越鲁棒性，保持ROC-AUC为0.7181
tldr: AudioFuse提出了一种混合架构，用宽而浅的ViT处理频谱图、浅层1D CNN处理原始波形，同时学习心音图的频域和时域互补特征，在从零训练的条件下达到最先进的分类性能（ROC-AUC 0.8608），并对域偏移展现出优异的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: AudioFuse proposes a hybrid architecture combining a wide-and-shallow ViT for spectrograms and a shallow 1D CNN for raw waveforms to jointly learn spectral and temporal features of phonocardiograms, achieving state-of-the-art classification performance (ROC-AUC 0.8608) trained from scratch with superior robustness to domain shift.
